inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,771 logical lines of the 24-page normalized article. The source develops a number-theoretic route from shifted zeta moments to long Dirichlet-polynomial mean squares, explains why polynomial length selects the number of recipe swaps, replaces the two-swap off-diagonal by a convolution of shifted divisor correlations through a Farey/circle-method splitting, treats semi-diagonal and fully nondegenerate cases, corrects decomposition multiplicities by automorphisms, and proves the required local arithmetic identities with power-series convolution algebra. The prose and proof architecture are coherent, while exact transcription of dense displayed factors remains text-layer/formula-risk evidence.
